description: Persist conflict detection events, resolution methods/outcomes, auto-placement verdicts and overrides, and build status deltas; suppress historical success rates until N≥5 observations; override tracking is the primary signal for ladder calibration and recipe candidate identification.

requirements.description: Cartographer must persist analytics events to a local SQLite database from v0.1 (AC-ANALYTICS-SCHEMA). Events captured must include: conflict detection (AC-ANALYTICS-EVENTS), resolution method and outcome, auto-placement verdicts and overrides, build status deltas, and --force notes. CLI commands arch-cart history (AC-ANALYTICS-HISTORY) and arch-cart stats (AC-ANALYTICS-STATS) must query the store. Historical success rates must be suppressed until N≥5 observations exist for a given pattern (AC-ANALYTICS-THRESHOLD). Override tracking must be the primary signal for signal-weight calibration (AC-ANALYTICS-OVERRIDES). No external resource dependency is permitted for analytics storage.
requirements.title: Analytics Persistence from Day One — SQLite Event Store

validation.notes: AC-ANALYTICS-SCHEMA: SQLite schema migrations are idempotent and versioned
AC-ANALYTICS-EVENTS: Detection event is inserted with conflict_id, type, severity, scenario, and timestamp
AC-ANALYTICS-EVENTS: Resolution event is inserted with conflict_id, method, outcome, and timestamp
AC-ANALYTICS-EVENTS: Override event is inserted with signal_name, original_domain, overridden_domain, and timestamp
AC-ANALYTICS-THRESHOLD: arch-cart stats for a conflict type with <5 observations returns 'insufficient data' instead of a success rate
AC-ANALYTICS-THRESHOLD: arch-cart stats for a conflict type with ≥5 observations returns a calculated success rate
AC-ANALYTICS-OVERRIDES: arch-cart stats --overrides lists signals ordered by override frequency
End-to-end: run detection → resolve → apply cycle; all three event types appear in arch-cart history output
arch-cart history filters by scenario, conflict type, and date range and returns only matching events
SQLite database file is created in the scenario's local directory with no network calls during any analytics operation
Override history is sufficient to propose signal weight adjustments in the calibration command (REQ-P2-005)
A scenario owner can audit the full decision history for a migration using arch-cart history without external tooling

title: Analytics from Day One
